name: obsidian
description: Connect duya to a local Obsidian vault through the official desktop `obsidian` CLI: search and read notes, create or update pages, manage links, tasks, properties, templates, and local history.

interface.shortDescription: Search and edit your local Obsidian vault
interface.longDescription: Connect duya to your local Obsidian vault through the official desktop `obsidian` CLI. Search and read notes, create or update pages, manage backlinks, tasks, properties, templates, and restore from local note history. Requires the Obsidian desktop app with the official CLI enabled; the bundled skill works against your local vault directly.
